Text output

Source: R/text.R
pub_text.Rd

Joins lines into one Markdown text and checks that it has no headings (use sections for structure). Steps may also return plain character vectors, which the document builder checks in the same way.

Usage

pub_text(x, title = NULL)

Arguments

x

Character vector of lines.

title

character(1) heading line shown above the text (not a section) or NULL (as is a blank string).

Value

character(1) with metadata (see pub_meta()).

Details

Supported Markdown

The same in HTML, DOCX and PDF:

MarkdownResult
blank linenew paragraph
*italic*, **bold**, `code`emphasis and code
[link](url)link
- item, 1. itembullet and numbered lists
backslash at the end of a lineline break
$...$, $$...$$ (on its own lines)inline and display math
fenced code blockcode block
[<insert value>]{.placeholder}highlighted text to fill in

A placeholder marks a gap that someone fills in by hand later, e.g. in the Word report. It is highlighted in every format, so it is not overlooked.

Cross-references

@fig:<id> and @tab:<id> refer to the figure or table with that id (see pub_meta() and pub_figure()) and become a link "Figure 1" or "Table 2". The word is set by labels in the report spec. In Word they are cross-reference fields.

  • The figure or table needs a caption (only captions are numbered) and its id must be unique in the document.

  • References in code, math, placeholders, links and image descriptions stay text, as do \@fig:x and a@fig:x.

  • A reference that can't be resolved is an error in pub_render() and pub_markdown(). pub_html() and the viewer warn and mark it, so a draft still displays.

See also

pub_md_escape() for data in the text, pub_meta(), pub_type()

Examples

txt <- pub_text(
    c(
        "The mean difference is **2.5 units** ($p = 0.03$).",
        "",
        "- group A",
        "- group B",
        "",
        "See [<insert link>]{.placeholder} and @fig:trend."
    ),
    title = "Summary"
)
writeLines(txt)
#> The mean difference is **2.5 units** ($p = 0.03$).
#> 
#> - group A
#> - group B
#> 
#> See [<insert link>]{.placeholder} and @fig:trend.
pub_meta(txt)
#> $title
#> [1] "Summary"
#> 

# Display math, numbered list and code block
writeLines(pub_text(c(
    "The fitted model is",
    "",
    "$$",
    "y = a + b x",
    "$$",
    "",
    "1. fit the model",
    "2. check the residuals",
    "",
    "```",
    "lm(y ~ x)",
    "```"
)))
#> The fitted model is
#> 
#> $$
#> y = a + b x
#> $$
#> 
#> 1. fit the model
#> 2. check the residuals
#> 
#> ```
#> lm(y ~ x)
#> ```

try(pub_text(c("# Results", "Text")))
#> Error in pub_text(c("# Results", "Text")) : 
#>   Text must not contain headings (use sections):
#> ✖ line 1: "# Results"
